violation_type.title: Storage of Medication - Refrigerate Separate from Food (26 TAC §747.3607(3))
violation_type.short_title: Storage of Medication - Refrigerate Separate from Food
violation_type.typical_finding: Serveral bottles of medication was observed to be stored next to food    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the medication was removed and stored spearately

finding_variants.text: Serveral bottles of medication was observed to be stored next to food    NOTE: Corrected at inspection, the medication was removed and stored spearately

During the inspection I observed a bottle of prescription medication in the refrigerator on the shelf with food.      This was corrected when the caregiver placed the bottle of medication on a door shelf away from food.
